title: Structural Intelligence Compass: A 12-Point Research Compass for Structural Intelligence
description: The Structural Intelligence Compass is a compact, open research framework for examining intelligence, computation, reasoning, organization, and their boundaries from twelve structural directions. The Compass is organized into four groups: three fundamental challenges concerning relative versus absolute truth, extrapolation boundaries, and computational difficulty; three structural foundations concerning differential-tree structures, Calling Graphs, and Calling-Path Folding; three engineering directions concerning PDOS/PDOR, Core-Preserved Generation, and Local Node Intelligence; and three research frontiers concerning Multi-Perspective Function Tunnels, Structural Extrapolation and Confidence, and Hybrid Intelligence. The repository also develops the concepts of Perspective-Limited Truth, Boundary Intelligence, a Minimal Structural Basis for Broad Intelligence, Basis Stress Testing, and Residual Intelligence. It is intentionally presented as a compass rather than a closed map: an invitational framework intended for collective examination, challenge, extension, and revision.
notes: Initial public research release. The Structural Intelligence Compass is intentionally open-ended and does not claim that the twelve Compass points or the proposed structural basis are complete. The repository is designed to support collective learning, counterexamples, Basis Stress Testing, and future revision.
